settings.fileImport.title: Import Files
settings.fileImport.description: Drop in any file — text, PDF, Word, Excel, or a zip of several — and it's turned into memories. Text is extracted where possible; other formats still record that the file arrived rather than being silently dropped. No size limit is enforced by the app itself.
settings.admissionGate.title: Admission Gate (preview)
settings.admissionGate.description: Preview how a candidate memory would be judged before storing: admitted, held for review (near-duplicate), redacted (secrets stripped), or rejected (too short / an exact duplicate). This is read-only — it does not store anything.
settings.admissionGate.placeholder: Paste candidate memory text to evaluate…
settings.backupRestore.title: Backup & Restore
settings.backupRestore.description: A full snapshot of every memory (with its decay state) and session. Set a passphrase to encrypt the file at rest — it's the only way to read it back, so store it safely; it cannot be recovered.
settings.backupRestore.replaceWarning: Replace mode deletes all current memories and sessions before restoring.
settings.trustProvenance.title: Trust & provenance
settings.trustProvenance.description: A deterministic, explainable provenance signal — where a memory came from, how many independent sources corroborate it, and whether it carries risk flags. This is not a truth score, and it never changes recall ranking.
settings.privacyRedaction.title: Privacy & Redaction
settings.privacyRedaction.description: Scan stored memories for secrets (credentials, tokens, API keys) that slipped in before the admission gate existed, and strip them in place.
settings.privacyRedaction.confirmRedactA: Redact secrets from all flagged memories? This rewrites their content in place.
app.decisions.title: Decisions
app.decisions.subtitle: Decisions detected across your memories — “we decided”, “agreed to”, “karar verdik”. Fully offline, no manual tagging.
app.decisions.empty.title: No decisions detected in the last {days} days.
app.decisions.empty.hint: Decisions are picked up automatically from memory content — meeting notes, transcripts, and captured discussions.

app.review.title: Review
app.review.subtitle: Spaced-repetition review of fading memories — the last step of the lifecycle. Decide what to keep, reinforce, weaken, pin, snooze, or forget before they decay away.
app.review.empty.title: Nothing due for review — your memory is in good shape.
app.review.empty.hint: Memories appear here as their predicted retention drops below 50%.
settings.connectClient.title: Connect an AI Client
settings.connectClient.description: Set up MCP (Model Context Protocol) to give your AI tools persistent memory. Select your client below and copy the config.
settings.connectClient.cliAlternative: Or generate configs from the CLI:
app.conflicts.title: Conflicts
app.conflicts.subtitle: Deterministic conflict-CANDIDATE review — memories that share an entity and show an opposing surface pattern (antonym, negation, or a differing attribute value). This is a signal for a human to review, never a verdict, and nothing is ever auto-deleted.
app.conflicts.empty: No open conflict candidates. Deterministic signal only — never a verdict.
app.graph.related.title: Related entities
app.graph.related.help: Line thickness scales with how often each pair co-occurs in the same memory.
app.graph.title: Graph
app.graph.subtitle: The persistent entity knowledge graph — people, organizations, events, documents, and tasks extracted from your memories, and how they connect.
app.graph.empty.title: No entities yet.
app.graph.empty.hint: Click Reindex to build the entity graph from your captured memories.
app.sessions.title: Sessions
app.sessions.subtitle: Group related memories. Ending a session consolidates its short-term memories into long-term storage. Summarize distills a session into one durable memory (LLM if configured, offline otherwise).
app.sessions.empty.beforeTool: No sessions yet. Create one above, or let your AI client call the
app.sessions.summarizeTitle: Distill this session's memories into one durable summary
settings.dataManagement.title: Data Management
settings.dataManagement.fullExport.descr: Full audit export — memories, entity graph, trust scores, and conflict candidates in one file. For auditing or backing up everything, not just memories.
settings.dataManagement.dedupe.found: Found {count} removable duplicates. Click “Remove duplicates” to delete them.
settings.dataManagement.similar.applied: Consolidated {clusters} cluster(s), archiving {memories} memories into durable summaries.
settings.dataManagement.similar.none: No consolidatable clusters (need ≥2 related, unpinned memories older than 7 days).
settings.dataManagement.similar.found: Found {clusters} cluster(s) covering {memories} memories. Click “Consolidate” to compress them.
settings.dataManagement.similar.help: Consolidation compresses clusters of related, aged (>7d), unpinned memories into one durable summary each — like sleep consolidating episodes into a gist. Originals are archived inside the summary, not lost.
settings.serverConfiguration.title: Server Configuration
settings.serverConfiguration.help: Every memory has its own half-life that starts at the default and grows every time it's recalled or reinforced — like spaced repetition. Configure via environment variables
app.findings.title: Findings
app.findings.subtitle: What LEVH noticed about itself and its environment. Every entry is a report, never an action: nothing here changes code, runs a command, or leaves this machine. Repeats fold into one row — the counter says how often a problem was seen, not how many reports piled up.
app.findings.empty: Nothing here. An empty inbox means nothing was reported, not that nothing is wrong.
